resources.string: Keep Ramflux out of sleeping apps
In Settings, open Battery, then Background usage limits. Make sure Ramflux is not in Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps, and add it to Never sleeping apps.
Turn on Autostart for Ramflux so that it can start in the background when a message or call arrives.
Allow lock screen and background pop-ups

In the app\'s other permissions, allow Show on lock screen, Display pop-up windows while running in the background and Start in background. Also turn on lock screen and floating notifications for Messages and Calls.
Set the battery saver for Ramflux to No restrictions.
Open the recent apps screen and lock the Ramflux card (touch and hold it, or use the lock icon), so that clearing the list does not stop it.
Open App launch, switch Ramflux to Manage manually, then turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.
Open App launch, switch Ramflux to Manage manually, then turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.
Turn on Auto launch for Ramflux so that it can start in the background when a message or call arrives.
In the app\'s Battery usage page, allow Background activity, Auto launch and Foreground activity.
Turn on Autostart (background startup) for Ramflux.
Under Background power consumption management, allow Ramflux to use high background power.
If STAMINA mode is on, exclude Ramflux from it when offered, or turn it off while you expect calls.
In Phone Master, allow Autostart for Ramflux.
In Phone Master, remove Ramflux from app power saving and background limits.
In Mobile Manager, allow Ramflux in the Auto-start manager.
